paragraphs.en: The little prince spoke of men traveling by express trains without knowing their destination. "It's not worth the trouble," he concluded.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子提到那些乘坐快速列车却不了解目的地的人们。“这样做不值得，”他总结道。

paragraphs.en: We had reached a well unlike those in the Sahara, which were mere sand holes. This one seemed like a village well, though no village was nearby. I thought I must be dreaming.
paragraphs.zh: 我们来到的水井与撒哈拉沙漠中的那些完全不同，后者不过是些沙坑。这个水井看起来像一个村庄里的水井，尽管附近并没有任何村落。我觉得自己一定是做夢了。

paragraphs.en: "Everything is ready for use: the pulley, bucket, and rope," I said to him.
paragraphs.zh: 我对他说：“所有工具都准备好了：滑轮、吊桶和绳索都已经就绪。”

paragraphs.en: He laughed, touched the rope, and started the pulley. It moaned softly, like an old weathervane forgotten by the wind.
paragraphs.zh: 他笑了，摸了摸绳子，启动了滑轮。滑轮轻轻地发出呻吟声，仿佛是被遗忘在风中的旧风向标。

paragraphs.en: "Do you hear?" he asked. "We've woken the well, and it's singing..."
paragraphs.zh: “你听见没有？”他喊道，“我们吵醒了井底之蛙，它已经开始唱歌了……”

paragraphs.en: I offered to take over the task of raising the bucket. "It's too heavy for you," I said.
paragraphs.zh: 我主动提出接下提水的任务。“这桶太重了，你拿不动。”我说。

paragraphs.en: Slowly, I hoisted the bucket to the edge of the well and set it there. The song of the pulley still echoed in my ears as I watched the sunlight shimmer on the water that was trembling with its own freshness.
paragraphs.zh: 慢慢地，我将水桶提到井口，放在那里。滑轮的歌声仍在耳畔回响，阳光在那微微颤动、充满清新气息的水面跳跃闪烁。

paragraphs.en: "I am thirsty for this water," he said. "Give me some to drink..."
paragraphs.zh: “我渴得很呢，”他说道，“给我喝点吧……”

paragraphs.en: I understood what he had been seeking all along. I raised the bucket to his lips, and he drank deeply, his eyes closed. The water tasted sweet, like a special treat.
paragraphs.zh: 我明白了他一直以来所寻找的是什么。我把桶举到他的嘴边，他闭着眼睛大口喝了起来。那水尝起来甜丝丝的，仿佛是一种特别的奖赏。

paragraphs.en: It was more than just nourishment; its sweetness came from walking under the stars, hearing the pulley's song, and my effort.
paragraphs.zh: 这不仅仅是滋养，它的甜美来自于在星空下漫步、聆听滑轮的歌声以及我的努力。

paragraphs.en: "The men where you live," said the little prince, "raise five thousand roses in one garden but do not find what they seek."
paragraphs.zh: “你们那边的人，”小王子说，“种了一万朵玫瑰却找不到他们所寻求的东西。”

paragraphs.en: "They do not find it," I replied.
paragraphs.zh: “他们找不到它。”我回答道。

paragraphs.en: "And yet, what they are looking for could be found in a single rose or a little water," he added.
paragraphs.zh: “然而，他们寻找的东西也许就在一朵玫瑰或一滴水中。”他补充道。

paragraphs.en: "Yes, that is true," I agreed.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，确实如此。”我应道。

paragraphs.en: "But the eyes are blind; one must look with the heart..."
paragraphs.zh: “但眼睛会欺骗人；必须用心去看……”

paragraphs.en: I had drunk the water and breathed easily as the sunrise turned the sand honey-colored, bringing me an unexpected happiness. The little prince sat beside me, saying softly, "You must keep your promise."
paragraphs.zh: 随着日出将沙地染成蜂蜜般的颜色，我喝下了那水，感到轻松自如，意外的幸福感油然而生。小王子坐在我的身旁，轻声说道：“你必须遵守你的承诺。”

paragraphs.en: "What promise?" I asked.
paragraphs.zh: “什么承诺？”我问道。

paragraphs.en: "A muzzle for my sheep... I am responsible for this flower..."
paragraphs.zh: “为我的羊戴上了笼嘴……这朵花的责任在我身上……”

paragraphs.en: I pulled out my rough sketches of drawings. He laughed and commented on my baobabs, comparing them to cabbages. Then he pointed out the horns-like ears of my fox drawing, causing him to laugh again.
paragraphs.zh: 我拿出了一些粗糙的草图。他笑了笑，评论起我画的猴面包树，说它们像大白菜。接着他指出了我狐狸画中耳朵像牛角的部分，再次惹得他自己笑了起来。

paragraphs.en: "You are not fair, little prince," I said. "I don't know how to draw anything except boa constrictors from the outside and inside."
paragraphs.zh: “你不够公正，小王子，”我说，“我只会画蟒蛇的内外样子。”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, that will be all right," he replied. "Children understand."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，这没问题，”他回答道，“孩子们都能懂。”

paragraphs.en: He then made a pencil sketch of a muzzle, which tore at my heart as I gave it to him.
paragraphs.zh: 他随后用铅笔勾勒出一个枪口的轮廓，我接过画作时心中不禁一阵悸动。

paragraphs.en: "You have plans that I do not know about," I said.
paragraphs.zh: “你有我不知道的计划。”我说。

paragraphs.en: Silently, he mentioned his descent to Earth and its upcoming anniversary the next day. He flushed, and I felt a strange sense of sorrow.
paragraphs.zh: 他默默提到了自己降临人间以及第二天即将来临的周年纪念日。他脸红了，我心中涌起一股莫名的哀伤。

paragraphs.en: "Wasn't your arrival on the morning we met by chance—thousands of miles from any inhabited region?" I asked hesitantly.
paragraphs.zh: “我们初次见面的那个早晨，你突然造访，难道不是偶然的——距离任何有人烟的地方数千英里之遥？”我犹豫着问道。

paragraphs.en: He flushed again. "Perhaps it was because of the anniversary," I added.
paragraphs.zh: 他又有些脸红，“也许是因为纪念日的缘故吧,” 我补充道。

paragraphs.en: He flushed once more, never answering my questions. His flushes seemed to confirm his affirmative thoughts.
paragraphs.zh: 他又一次脸红了，却没有回答我的问题。他的脸红似乎证实了他的确有所隐瞒。

paragraphs.en: "Ah," I said, feeling a little frightened.
paragraphs.zh: “啊，”我说道，心里略感惊恐。

paragraphs.en: But he interrupted me, saying, "Now you must work and return to your engine. I will be waiting for you here. Come back tomorrow evening..."
paragraphs.zh: 但他打断我说：“你现在得回去工作，回到你的发动机旁。我会在这里等着你。明天晚上再来……”

paragraphs.en: Despite his reassurance, I was not fully comforted, remembering the fox and the risk of tears if one lets oneself be tamed.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管他一再安慰我，我还是感到不安，想起那只狐狸和被驯化后可能流下的泪水。
